text: 1.Have a high school degree or above, and be between 18 and 35 years old. 2. Foreigners who are in good health, have a reliable financial support system in place, and have a guardian. 3. If both parents or one of the parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled abroad, and the individual was born with foreign nationality, starting from 2021, students applying to enter our higher education institutions for undergraduate or junior college studies as international students must, in addition to meeting the other admission requirements of the school, also hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for 4 years (inclusive) or more, and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for 2 years or more within the last 4 years (up to April 30 of the year of admission). 4. If you have ever studied or lived in China, you must not have any record of illegal or disciplinary violations.
